items.name: CREEM 2.0
items.tagline: Sell and grow your AI built products
items.description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.

items.name: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
items.tagline: Cloud Macs your coding agents can actually build on
items.description: Bitrise RDE gives you cloud Macs & Linux machines that start in seconds, the same machines, stacks and caches as your CI. Give every agent its machine and run them in parallel via MCP, or attach VS Code, Cursor or Claude Code. Archive when you stop, restore later.

items.name: Modaal for Android
items.tagline: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
items.description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.

items.name: Text Agent Store
items.tagline: A marketplace for AI agents you can text
items.description: Meet all the agents you can text. Agent Store is a directory of AI agents that live inside a contact in your phone book. Browse an ecosystem of texting agents, and send one text to start using them today. No account, no download, no setup.

items.name: NovaSynth by Noveum
items.tagline: Test your voice agent on the callers you can’t stage.
items.description: Simulate realistic callers at scale with custom personas, scenarios, interruptions, noise, accents, and network conditions. NovaSynth runs those calls against your voice agent, scores audio and transcripts across 30+ dimensions, and surfaces the failures and fixes that matter to your team.

items.name: Higgsfield API
items.tagline: One async API for 50+ generative media models
items.description: Higgsfield API is one authenticated, asynchronous API for generative media. Call Seedance, Kling, Soul, Grok Imagine, Wan, and 50+ frontier models through the same request lifecycle — submit, poll or webhook, download. Explore models in Console, get keys in Cloud, ship with Python/TypeScript SDKs. Pay per use with intro discounts up to 50% off your top models. Build your own Higgsfield at open.higgsfield.ai.

items.name: MCPJam
items.tagline: The testing & evaluations platform for MCP servers
items.description: Run User Testing, Swarms, Evals, and CI/CD gates on your MCP server to see if users actually succeed in ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Test local servers via desktop app, CLI, or SDK.

items.name: Die With Me
items.tagline: AIM buddy list for your friends’ Claude Code and Codex usage
items.description: An AIM buddy list for your AI usage. See friends’ Claude Code and Codex allowances as little mascots on your Mac. Set a status, visit their rooms, and unlock a chatroom when your allowance runs low. Your AI clocks out, but your friends are still here.

items.name: TinyKPI
items.tagline: Your business analytics directly in your notch
items.description: Connect the tools you already usefrom Stripe and PostHog to Google Analytics and your own database. Pick the KPIs you care about, arrange them your way, and keep them live in a tiny, customizable dashboard built around your MacBook notch. 100% local. Your data never leaves your Mac.

items.name: Figo
items.tagline: See every move your competitors make
items.description: Figo watches your competitors so you do not have to. Every week it checks their rankings, new pages, blog posts, Google Ads, Meta ads, TikTok ads, Instagram, Facebook and Reddit, plus what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity say when buyers ask for a recommendation. Monday morning you get a short briefing: what changed, what it means, and one thing to do about it. Add your website and it finds the competitors for you.

items.name: Zella
items.tagline: Video recorder that edits itself on Mac and iPhone
items.description: Zella records your screen or camera and edits the video for you, on your own Mac or iPhone. Nothing uploads, no account, no subscription. Free at 1080p with no watermark. One tap runs Auto-Polish: captions, silence cuts, filler words removed, zoom-ins and a cleaned-up voice. Make it Viral adds pacing, transitions, sound effects and a music bed. Pro is one payment of $89 that unlocks Mac and iPhone together, for life, instead of a monthly bill.

items.name: Blanc
items.tagline: A minimal browser with a floating island for a toolbar
items.description: Blanc is a free desktop browser for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its floating Island replaces the tab strip and toolbar, while ad and tracker blocking runs at the network layer. Optional Patron adds Named Workspaces.

items.name: Pitchfire for Startups
items.tagline: Reach investors that are aligned with you
items.description: Pitchfire for Startups is a new channel to reach investors. Upload your pitch deck, get matched to VCs with our AI, and let Pitchfire hype your startup with an email intro. Pitchfire brings investors and startups togethr. Over the past year, we've built AI associates for VC firms, and are now inverting the tech to match startups up with VCs. Sign up to get matched and intro'd to three investors a day. Upload your investor lists and we'll intro you if we have their contact data.

items.name: Axiom
items.tagline: The modern machine data platform
items.description: The modern machine data platform — Petabyte-scale, schema-less ingest on a fully managed event store, so you keep every byte without the operational cost of running it yourself.

items.name: MacSentinel
items.tagline: Find what’s slowing your Mac then clean it safely
items.description: MacSentinel brings Mac monitoring, diagnosis, storage analysis, and cleanup into one native workflow. Instead of simply showing system metrics or deleting generic caches, it explains likely causes of slowdowns locally, then helps you act safely. Smart Care includes 500+ app rules across 50 categories, covering developer, creative, productivity, and AI tools. Cleanup is Trash-first and recoverable, and Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription.

items.name: The Forge by Bob's Workshop
items.tagline: Describe your idea & your team builds, deploys & operates it
items.description: The Forge gives you an entire development, sales, and marketing team. Describe what you want to build in plain language. They plan it, design it, build it, and deploy it. No code required. Every app ships with a production quality database and auth system, ai model options, payment integration, built-in CRM, brand management, and autonomous maintenance. Unlike Lovable, Bolt, or Replit — The Forge doesn't just generate code. It operates your product and builds your business.

items.name: Compute:Arena
items.tagline: Community submitted benchmarks for Local AI
items.description: Community-submitted performance benchmarks for local AI models on any hardware, any runtime, any quantisation.

items.name: AskDeck
items.tagline: Call an AI to get a PowerPoint and a narrated video back
items.description: Every other AI deck tool makes you sit at a laptop and type a prompt. This one you can call. Brief Eric by phone, SMS, email or web — or from inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP. An editable PowerPoint (pptx) and a narrated video that presents it come back. Free watermarked preview: no account, no card. $29 once for the real file, yours to keep, no subscription required. Have a half-done deck? Upload it and Eric finishes it — polish, reskin to your brand, or build it out.

items.name: Opyt
items.tagline: Your attention is the context your AI is missing
items.description: Opyt turns the people and topics you already follow into a knowledge base. Point it at your X bookmarks, Substack subscriptions, blogs, GitHub repos or arXiv papers, and it pulls in their archives. It reads a topic through, writes its own follow-up questions, and keeps looking for new work that builds on what you've collected. Share what your knowledge base, keep exploring, and let your AI read it all. Free, MIT licensed, and your knowledge base can stay local.

items.name: QAgent
items.tagline: Automated QA for AI agents. Stop shipping on vibes.
items.description: Automate AI agent quality testing. Score correctness, detect hallucinations against ground truth, verify policy adherence, and benchmark RAG before bad responses reach real customers.
